Rows.query: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM SpecObj s JOIN galSpecInfo i ON s.specObjID=i.specObjID JOIN PhotoObj p ON s.bestObjID=p.objID JOIN galSpecExtra x ON s.specObjID=x.specObjID WHERE s.class='GALAXY' AND s.z BETWEEN 0.02 AND 0.12 AND x.lgm_tot_p50 BETWEEN 8 AND 12.5 AND x.specsfr_tot_p50>=-11 AND x.specsfr_tot_p50<-10.5
